description: This source file implements the SecApi class and related components for managing cryptographic keys and generating/mac-ing tokens within a security framework. It includes functions for key generation, deletion, MAC computation, token encoding, and signature validation, specifically tailored for JWT security handling.

classes.name: JWTSecApi
classes.description: Main class providing JWT token encoding, decoding, signature validation, and cryptographic key management with internal support for secure algorithms.

classes.name: JWTSecApi::SecApi
classes.description: Handles direct interactions with cryptographic processing hardware or software, such as key management and MAC computation.

classes.name: JWTSecApi::MacGenerator
classes.description: Utility class for generating HMAC signatures used in JWT token signing.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token, appends a MAC signature.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token, verifies its signature, retrieves payload.

methods.name: PayloadLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the payload in the token.

methods.name: ValidSignature
methods.description: Verifies if the token's signature matches the expected MAC.
